title: Pistachio Stuffed American Pizza
description: A twist on the classic American pizza with a pistachio-stuffed crust, gooey cheese, and a pungent flavor.
instructions: Roll out the pizza dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread the pistachio paste evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Sprinkle the shredded American cheese and gooey mozzarella cheese over the pistachio paste.
Mince the pungent garlic and sprinkle it over the cheese.
Drizzle the tomato sauce over the garlic.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh basil leaves over the sauce.
Roll the dough into a tight log and place it on a baking sheet.
Bake the pizza for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the pizza from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Slice the pizza into 8 equal pieces and serve.
